hypothesis: Y034 quorum2 loses some full-cache benefits in drift4 and late shocks; combining a fixed legal-preference quorum2 with a current-graph degree-at-most-four filter may reduce collateral assignment movement under those conditions while preserving useful continuity.
freeze: One composite policy with the exact degree4 cap and quorum2 threshold, fixed four regimes and new cohorts preregistered before first-use. No post-result policy or threshold selection.
source: Exact Y034 seven active /16 total motif-cell generator, nine cached inactive assignments max, four-way collision, radius-two neighborhoods, eight episodes and frozen drift1,drift2,drift4,late_shock schedules.
policies: matched_sham: identical cache writes, no cache preference read
full: legal remembered assignments used every time
quorum2: legal cache preferences if >=2 distinct active eligible keys
quorum2_conflict4: consider only legal cached preference cells whose current graph neighborhood degree<=4, then apply if >=2 eligible keys
evaluation: Same independent exhaustive Hall7 check; cache keys, writes and occupancy must agree across arms; policy accesses only present active graph and observed prior cached placements.
outcome: COMPOSITE_GAIN iff composite churn is strictly below quorum2 under both drift4 and late_shock and retains >=70% of full-cache sham-relative saving under drift1. PARTIAL if composite improves in either drift4 or late_shock but strict threshold fails. NO_GAIN otherwise. Preserve adverse/no-effect results and comparison against no-cache.
claim_limit: Synthetic current-graph memory selection without semantic cognition or production authority.
